_comment: Plain, hand-editable lookup for GET /filing-guidance — no migration needed to add or correct an entry. portal_url is deliberately left null everywhere: government portal URLs change without notice and an out-of-date or wrong link is worse than no link, so the app only ever names a portal, never guesses its address. 'default' is returned for any state not listed below.

default.note: Filing deadlines and procedures are set by your State Internal Revenue Service (a separate body from the federal Nigeria Tax Act this app implements) — search for your state's official tax portal to file and confirm this year's deadline.

Lagos.note: Lagos State Internal Revenue Service's online filing portal. Search "LIRS eTax" to find the current official link.

FCT (Abuja).note: The FCT Internal Revenue Service's online filing portal. Search "FCT-IRS Taxportal" to find the current official link.

Rivers.note: Rivers State's online tax administration portal. Search "RIVTAMIS" to find the current official link.
